Tree shows 'James (Living)' as a child of James Petriello and Mollie.

round5: The tree's 'James (Living)', child of James Petriello and Mollie, is the 'brother Jim Petriello and wife MaryEllen' who survived John T. Petriello Sr. in March 2025 ([R4-S1]). The obituary also confirms that Sr. was 'the son of the late James and Mollie Petriello' ([R4-S1]). Jim does not appear in the April 1940 household, which held only John (7) and Ann Marie (6) ([R4-S2]), so he was born later, after 1940 (round 4 found that the 1950 census shows the same two children).
